_meta.selection: MICHELIN Guide New York 2025 selection, announced 18 November 2025 (69 starred restaurants: 5 three-star, 14 two-star, 50 one-star in New York City).
_meta.star_caveat: THE NEXT NEW YORK CEREMONY IS SCHEDULED FOR 14 DECEMBER 2026 — before this trip. Re-verify every star after that date. Nothing on this page should be treated as final for Feb/Mar 2027.
_meta.one_star_discrepancy: MICHELIN's own New York filter reports 50 one-star restaurants in New York City; the 18 Nov 2025 announcement lists 52 one-star names including La Bastide by Andrea Calstier (North Salem, Westchester) and borough venues. The difference is FLAGGED here, not reconciled.
_meta.price_rule: Selected restaurants now show a couple subtotal only when a first-party menu, FAQ or PDF states a per-person price. Every figure is written as 2 × the official per-person amount and is NOT a quoted all-in total; beverages, tax and gratuity are excluded unless the official page says otherwise. All other rows remain blank and flagged unverified. No 2027 price inference is allowed.
_meta.in_or_near_nyc: Blue Hill at Stone Barns (Tarrytown) and La Bastide (North Salem) are outside the NYC subway network. They are kept in the list for completeness and marked 'outside transit rule'.
_meta.cluster_rule: A cluster is filled only where the MICHELIN page itself names the area. Two rows with a Guide-blurb clue (Daniel and Torrisi) still carry cluster_flag and are rendered as “Not yet grouped”; they are not silently verified.
_meta.hours_coverage: 27 of 72 rows have verified weekday hours.
_meta.one_star_hours_gap: 43 one-star rows still lack verified hours.
_meta.menu_price_integration: Final integration 2026-11-25: 10 starred rows carry selected official menu/FAQ/PDF prices. Couple figures are arithmetic (2 × official per-person amount), not quoted all-in totals; they exclude beverages, tax, and gratuity unless the official page says otherwise. No 2027 price is inferred.
_meta.price_arithmetic_rule: Computed as 2 × official per-person menu price; excludes beverages, tax, and gratuity unless the official page says otherwise; not a quoted all-in total or a 2027 price.
_meta.price_coverage: 10 of 72 starred rows have at least one verified official per-person menu price; 62 remain blank + unverified.
_meta.price_scalar_meaning: For priced rows, scalar price_for_two_usd and menu_price_per_person_usd are the LOWEST official option shown in price_options; they are not an all-in total. Use price_options for every individual 2 × official per-person amount and source link.
